I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/`, ran `scripts/check.sh`, which printed OK, and committed it as `2f6b541` ("2025-12: add rows").

The check only tests that each row has the right number of fields. It doesn't check values. One row, `R2512-003`, has the category `wholsale`, which looks like a typo for `wholesale`. I committed the file as it was. I didn't compare the category spellings against earlier months. If you want it fixed, I can correct it in a follow-up commit.

I left `inbox/2025-12.csv` where it was, since you asked me to add the file, not move it.
